sections.description:
SEO got you here. GEO takes you further.

Google isn’t the only one answering questions anymore. ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity are serving answers directly to your audience. TalkGenAI helps you create content that AI engines can trust, cite, and recommend.

AI-Powered Content Generation

Generate publish-ready articles right inside WordPress. Every article includes:

  • Internal Links – Automatically links to your existing content, building topical authority across your site
  • External Links – Cites authoritative sources that AI engines trust and verify
  • FAQ Sections – Structured Q&A that AI can pull directly into conversational answers
  • Meta Descriptions – Optimized summaries tuned for AI synthesis
  • Any Language – Write in English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, German, and more

Just type your topic, toggle on the features you want, and TalkGenAI generates a complete, GEO-ready article in seconds.

Interactive Widget Builder

TalkGenAI is also an AI-powered widget builder. Instead of configuring complex settings or hiring a developer, you describe what you need:

“Create a mortgage calculator with loan amount, interest rate, and term length” – done in 10 seconds.

  • Calculators – Mortgage, BMI, ROI, cost estimators, quote generators, loan, savings, currency converters
  • Countdown Timers – Sales countdowns, product launches, event timers, Pomodoro timers
  • Comparison Tables – Product specs, pricing plans, affiliate charts (AI researches the data for you)
  • To-Do Lists & Checklists – Onboarding flows, shopping lists, process trackers
  • More coming soon

Every widget is responsive, lightweight, and works with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and Beaver Builder via a simple shortcode.

How It Works (4 Steps)

  1. Open the TalkGenAI dashboard in your WordPress admin
  2. Type what you want: “Build a calorie calculator for women” or “Write an article about home workout routines”
  3. Preview the result – tweak it by chatting: “Add an FAQ section”, “Make the button blue”
  4. Copy the shortcode, paste it into any page or post

Why Site Owners Choose TalkGenAI

GEO-ready from day one. Your articles are structured with internal links, external citations, and FAQ sections that AI engines like ChatGPT and Gemini can trust and cite.

One plugin instead of many. Most sites need a calculator plugin, a timer plugin, a table plugin. That means 3+ plugins to maintain, update, and troubleshoot. TalkGenAI replaces them all.

No coding, no configuration screens. Other plugins make you drag fields around and configure formulas. With TalkGenAI, you describe the result and the AI writes the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Lightweight output. Each widget is self-contained code – no framework dependencies, no external scripts loaded on your frontend.

Real Examples

Here are actual prompts that produce working results:

  • “Write an article about the best protein powders for beginners” (generates article with internal links, external sources, and FAQ)
  • “Mortgage calculator – monthly payment based on home price, down payment, interest rate, and loan term”
  • “Countdown timer to December 31, 2026 with days, hours, minutes, seconds”
  • “Compare iPhone 16 vs Samsung S25 – screen, battery, camera, price” (AI fills in the specs)
  • “BMI calculator with metric and imperial units”
  • “Pricing table for 3 plans: Basic $9/mo, Pro $29/mo, Enterprise $99/mo”

Free Plan Included

Start building immediately:

  • 10 free generations per month
  • 5 active apps
  • All features (articles, calculators, timers, tables, checklists)
  • Internal links, external links, FAQ sections included
  • No credit card required

Starter Plan – $20/mo (Optional)

For professionals and agencies:

  • 50 generations per month
  • Premium AI models (GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet)
  • 20 active apps
  • AI Site Analysis – scans your site and suggests widgets that fit your niche
  • White Label – remove TalkGenAI branding
  • Use on unlimited websites

Privacy & External Service Notice

This plugin connects to an external API service to provide AI generation.

Service Provider:

  • Service: TalkGenAI
  • Service URL: https://app.talkgen.ai
  • Terms of Service: Read Terms
  • Privacy Policy: Read Privacy Policy

Data collected when you generate a widget or article:

  • The text prompt you enter (e.g., “Create a BMI calculator”)
  • WordPress site URL, WordPress version, PHP version (for compatibility)
  • Timestamp, IP address (for security), and User ID

Data we do NOT collect:

  • Your site’s database, posts, pages, or media
  • Passwords or personal credentials
  • Data from other plugins

You are responsible for reviewing and testing all generated widgets and articles before publishing. AI can make mistakes – always verify calculations and content.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “TalkGenAI”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Register for a free API key at https://app.talkgen.ai
  5. Enter your API key in TalkGenAI > Settings
  6. Go to TalkGenAI > Generate App and describe your first widget or article

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Register at https://app.talkgen.ai for your free API key
  6. Enter the key in TalkGenAI > Settings
sections.faq:
What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?

GEO is the shift from traditional SEO to optimizing for AI-powered search engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Instead of just ranking in Google, GEO ensures your content is structured so AI engines can trust, cite, and recommend it. TalkGenAI generates articles that are GEO-ready out of the box.

How do I get started?

Install the plugin, get a free API key at app.talkgen.ai, and type your first prompt. Watch the setup video for a quick walkthrough.

Is it really free?

Yes. The free plan gives you 10 generations per month and 5 active widgets. No credit card required. You can upgrade later if you need more.

Do I need to know HTML or JavaScript?

No. You describe what you want in any language – TalkGenAI supports English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, German, and more. The AI writes all the code.

How do the internal and external links work?

When generating an article, TalkGenAI scans your existing content to find relevant internal link opportunities and cites authoritative external sources. This builds topical authority and signals credibility to both traditional search engines and AI engines.

Can I customize the design after generating?

Yes. Just tell the AI what to change: “Make the background dark”, “Use a larger font”, “Add more FAQ questions”. You can iterate as many times as you want within a single generation.

Does it work with my page builder?

Yes. TalkGenAI outputs a standard WordPress shortcode like [talkgenai_app id="123"]. This works in Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and any theme that supports shortcodes.

Can I put multiple widgets on the same page?

Yes. Each widget is fully self-contained. You can place a calculator and a countdown timer on the same page and they work independently.

What kinds of calculators can it build?

Mortgage, BMI, ROI, cost estimators, quote generators, loan calculators, savings calculators, currency converters, calorie calculators, tip calculators – anything you can describe.
